packs.title: Back to the Future
packs.subtitle: DeLorean BACK · Hill Valley
packs.description: Travel through Hill Valley in the DeLorean BACK. Custom scenery, animated titles, film-inspired music and the iconic departure quote bring Back to the Future into Stunts. Includes the complete Windows installer and uninstaller.
packs.install: Extract BACK_TO_THE_FUTURE_STUNTS into your Stunts folder. Run INSTALLER.bat in Windows. To restore your previous files, run DESINSTALLER.bat.

packs.title: Guns N’ Roses
packs.subtitle: November Rain Edition
packs.description: A rose-pink Corvette inspired by the 1963 Sting Ray, a 3D guitar intro and native November Rain music. Includes the NORAIN2 track, custom dashboard and the complete V4 installer.
packs.install: Extract the entire ZIP directly into your Stunts game folder, keeping PAYLOAD and NRCOPY.COM. Run INSTALLE.bat in Windows, or type INSTALLE in DOSBox. Restore with DESINST in the same environment.

packs.title: Renault 5 Turbo
packs.subtitle: 1982 · Prost Edition · Johnny and Mary
packs.description: The 1982 Renault 5 Turbo in its red-and-white Prost edition, with its custom cockpit, VGA title artwork and animated intro. Four native music arrangements bring Johnny and Mary into Stunts.
packs.install: Place the complete RENA_INSTALLATION folder inside your Stunts game folder. Run INSTALLER.BAT in Windows. To restore your previous files, run DESINSTALLER.BAT.
packs.cover_alt: Original Renault 5 Turbo title screen from the pack, with Senna and Prost

packs.title: Plymouth Superbird NASCAR
packs.subtitle: 1970 · NASCAR · BIRD
packs.description: Bring the winged Plymouth Superbird to Stunts. This NASCAR edition includes the BIRD car, a custom cockpit, updated bodywork and paint schemes, plus development sources, technical previews and a documented torque curve.
packs.author: Alain il Professore · Hyperion Racing Team
packs.credits: Original 3D base by Alan Rotoi; NASCAR edition and custom cockpit by Alain il Professore.
packs.install: Extract the ZIP, then copy CARBIRD.RES, STBIRD.3SH, STDABIRD.VSH and STDBBIRD.VSH into your Stunts 1.1 VGA game folder. Back up previous BIRD files and move any competing STBIRD.P3S, STDABIRD.PVS and STDBBIRD.PVS out of the game folder. Read LIRE_MOI.txt for details.
packs.cover_alt: VGA pixel artwork inspired by the reference photo: blue Plymouth Superbird NASCAR number 43 racing past the grandstands.

packs.title: Nissan Maxima Drift Wagon
packs.subtitle: CARNIMA · Sakura Crash · V08
packs.description: Tokyo Drift meets Stunts: a Nissan racing wagon with eleven native paintjobs, custom cockpit, contrasting splitter, sunroof and 3D sakura-petal crash debris. V08 includes a recalibrated steering marker, installer, uninstaller, sources and technical audits.
packs.install: Extract the complete NIMA_DRIFT_WAGON_V08_COMPLETE folder inside your own Stunts directory. Run NIMAINST.BAT from that folder. Restore with NIMAUNIN.BAT; original matching files are backed up to NIMABAK.
packs.cover_alt: NIMA Drift Wagon number 68 drifting through cherry blossoms in the supplied Sakura Crash artwork

packs.title: Alpine A110 Berlinette
packs.subtitle: 1970 · 1600 S · A110
packs.description: The French Berlinette joins Stunts: eleven paintjobs, a custom cockpit with three pedals, retouched steering-wheel states and a gear-change animation. The complete pack includes a reversible installer and documentation in English and French.
packs.author: Alain il Professore · Hyperion Racing Team
packs.install: Extract the ZIP and place ALP_A110 directly inside your Stunts game folder. Close the game, then run INSTALL.BAT from ALP_A110. Restore previous A110 resources with UNINST.BAT from the same folder; keep the folder and its backup while installed.
packs.cover_alt: Blue classic Alpine A110 Berlinette on a winding mountain pass beneath snow-capped Alpine peaks, in VGA pixel art.

packs.title: AMX Leclerc
packs.subtitle: Main battle tank · LECL · V03
packs.description: A French main battle tank joins the Stunts garage. AMX Leclerc V03 includes the native LECL vehicle resource, 3D shape and VGA cockpit resources, supplied as the original four-file archive.
packs.author: Alain il Professore · Hyperion Racing Team
packs.install: Close Stunts. Extract the ZIP and copy CARLECL.RES, STLECL.3SH, STDALECL.VSH and STDBLECL.VSH into your Stunts 1.1 VGA game folder. Back up any existing LECL resources first. Move competing STLECL.P3S, STDALECL.PVS and STDBLECL.PVS outside the game folder if present. To restore, remove the four installed files and put back your original LECL files.
packs.cover_alt: Digitized VGA illustration of a camouflaged French Leclerc main battle tank on a dusty training ground.

packs.title: Tesla Cybertruck
packs.subtitle: Electric pickup · CYBT · FINAL
packs.description: The angular electric pickup joins Stunts with ten named paintjobs, native CYBT bodywork and a custom VGA cockpit. Download the original final archive and explore its colour lineup, from Robot inox to White Lies.
packs.author: Alain il Professore · Hyperion Racing Team
packs.install: Close Stunts. Back up any existing CYBT files. Extract the ZIP and copy CARCYBT.RES, STCYBT.3SH, STDACYBT.VSH and STDBCYBT.VSH into your Stunts 1.1 VGA game folder. Move competing STCYBT.P3S, STDACYBT.PVS and STDBCYBT.PVS outside the game folder if present. To uninstall, remove the four installed files and restore your backups.
packs.cover_alt: VGA pixel illustration of a stainless steel Tesla Cybertruck on an elevated Stunts track at sunset, with a loop in the distance.
